_comment: product + one Configuration_Entry per language. The Feature_Catalog lives in the
sibling feature-set.json and the bug ledger in bug-list.json (the doc's
three-file layout) — the only supported configuration format. The shared
orchestrator (test-server-common/orchestrator/) loads this trio and resolves
each entry's server from its Server_Location.
The Rust Language_Server lives in aws-crypto-tools-rust under prim-test-server/;
configPath names the DIRECTORY holding its per-server trio
